secondGen.heading: Shaun & Elaine
secondGen.body: The second generation at d'reena beauty — focused on educating every customer on what their skin actually needs, and continually reinventing our treatment menu with the latest, most advanced technology available.

vision.manifesto: We believe skin care should never be generic. Every treatment starts with understanding your skin's true condition — not a one-size routine, but a plan built around your specific concerns. For forty years that has meant real technology, real results, and real care, from Seremban's largest Dermalogica-certified beauty centre.

blurbs.Dry: Your skin tends to feel tight and can flake — it's craving deep, lasting hydration.
blurbs.Oily: Your skin produces extra oil, especially through the day — balancing that is key.
blurbs.Combination: Your T-zone runs oilier while cheeks stay drier — treatments should address both.
blurbs.Normal: Your skin is fairly balanced day to day — the focus is on maintaining and boosting its glow.

meta.title: Dermalogica
meta.description: Exclusive Dermalogica distributor in Seremban — the professional skin care behind every treatment at d'reena beauty.

hero.heading: The professional skin care behind every treatment
hero.body: Every facial at d'reena is built on Dermalogica — the professional-grade skin health brand trusted by therapists worldwide. As an exclusive distributor, we carry the full professional range and the training that goes with it, so what touches your skin is prescribed, not guessed.

newIn.heading: Just landed at d'reena
newIn.body: The newest additions to the professional range — ask your therapist to work these into your next treatment or home routine.

futurecode-booster.description: Inspired by biohacking principles — supports skin's longevity by enhancing natural repair and helping reduce visible signs of DNA-related damage: deepening lines, coarse texture and discolouration.

neurotouch.description: Facial sculpting skincare elevated by neuroscience — clinically shown to visibly restore facial symmetry for more sculpted-looking skin over an 8-week course.

water-cream.description: Clinically proven to boost collagen by 44% and elastin by 56%, with visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles in as little as 3 days.

why.heading: Skin health, not cosmetics
why.body: Dermalogica formulates for skin health rather than quick cosmetic effect — which is why it sits at the centre of a professional treatment menu rather than a retail shelf.

pillars.title: No irritants, by design
pillars.body: Free from artificial fragrance and colour, and the common irritants that quietly keep sensitive skin reactive.

pillars.title: Therapist-led, always
pillars.body: The professional range is only available through trained therapists — our team is certified and re-trained as formulas evolve.

pillars.title: Prescribed to your skin
pillars.body: Products are selected per skin, per visit — your treatment and your home routine work as one plan, not two.

ranges.heading: What we work with
ranges.body: A short introduction rather than a catalogue — your therapist selects the exact products at consultation.

rangeItems.Daily Skin Health: The everyday core — cleansers, exfoliants, moisturisers and SPF that form the base of almost every routine we prescribe.
rangeItems.Active Clearing: For breakout-prone and congested skin, including adult acne that also shows early signs of ageing.
rangeItems.PowerBright: Targeted brightening for pigmentation, dark spots and uneven tone — the backbone of our brightening treatments.
rangeItems.UltraCalming: Barrier repair and relief for sensitive, reactive and redness-prone skin.
rangeItems.AGE Smart & Retinol: Firming, smoothing and collagen-supporting actives for skin showing lines, laxity and loss of density.
rangeItems.Professional-only: Treatment-room strength exfoliants, masques and boosters that are never sold for home use — the reason a professional facial outperforms a home routine.

faceMapping.heading: Your skin, read zone by zone
faceMapping.body: Every treatment starts with a Dermalogica Face Mapping analysis — your therapist reads your face zone by zone to see what's actually happening, then builds the treatment around it.
steps: Zone-by-zone analysis of your skin's real condition.
